id: 05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S
title: 安全知识问答：气体、标识与作业许可（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/05_Safety Officer Interview Questions & Answers for Gulf Countries (Saudi Arabia) S（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
points.S2: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息
points.S3: 国内化学品标签看象形图
points.S4: 实验室危险作业要审批
points.S5: 受限空间：严禁盲目施救

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到安全知识问答！
overlay: 安全知识问答：气体、标识与作业许可

shots.scene: 气体瓶、火焰、标签、挂锁、井口五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a gas cylinder, a flame, a blank chemical label, a padlock with a blank tag, and a manhole opening. No people.
shots.narration: 今天问气体、火、标识和作业许可。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室门口闻到怪味，皱眉捂鼻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a lab doorway, wrinkling his nose and covering it with his hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰闻到一股臭鸡蛋味。

shots.scene: 阿杰想凑近通风柜再闻一闻，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning in to sniff toward a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他想凑近闻闻，看是哪来的。

shots.scene: 小研拉住阿杰，指向墙上的气体报警器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds back the young male student and points at a gas detector mounted on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拉住他：别闻，先看报警器。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这些问题，我们一题一题来答。

shots.scene: 小研戴着安全员袖标，在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing a blank armband walks through a lab with a blank clipboard, checking benches.
shots.narration: 第一题：安全员要做些什么？

shots.scene: 小研向老周汇报，指着空白清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, pointing at a blank checklist on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 向负责人提出安全建议。

shots.scene: 小研看着阿杰操作，点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the young male student working at a bench in a lab coat and safety glasses, and nods.
shots.narration: 检查大家是否按规定操作。

shots.scene: 实验前，小研给阿杰做简短讲解
shots.prompt_en: Before an experiment, the female graduate student gives a short safety briefing to the young male student at the bench.
shots.narration: 实验前做个简短的安全交底。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标对准危害三角，旁边是盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon over a yellow warning triangle, with an arrow pointing to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 找出危害，提出控制办法。

shots.scene: 培训、会议、检查、审核四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a classroom board, a meeting table, a clipboard with a check, and a magnifying glass over a document. No people.
shots.narration: 组织培训、会议、检查和审核。

shots.scene: 小研和王老师一起翻看空白规程文件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the safety administrator look through blank procedure documents together.
shots.narration: 参与编写规程、预案和手册。

shots.scene: 放大镜和事故报告图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon over a blank incident report with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还要参与事故调查。

shots.scene: 气体分子图标，颜色透明，旁边一个鸡蛋图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of colorless gas molecules next to a cracked egg icon with wavy smell lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：硫化氢有什么特点？

shots.scene: 骷髅图标和火焰图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A skull pictogram and a flame pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 它有毒，而且易燃。

shots.scene: 看不见的气体沉在地面低处的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple room cross-section icon with a faint gas layer pooling near the floor and a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 无色，比空气重，会积在低处。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标，旁边打叉
shots.prompt_en: A nose icon with smell lines, crossed out with a red X, next to a gas detector icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度高了会麻痹嗅觉，不能靠闻。

shots.scene: 两个气体分子图标：一个碳一个氧、一个碳两个氧
shots.prompt_en: Two simple molecule icons side by side: one carbon with one oxygen, one carbon with two oxygens. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：一氧化碳和二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 两个透明气体云图标，旁边是被划掉的眼睛和鼻子
shots.prompt_en: Two transparent gas cloud icons next to an eye icon and a nose icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 两种气体都无色无味。

shots.scene: 一氧化碳旁有火焰图标，二氧化碳旁火焰被划掉
shots.prompt_en: One gas cloud icon with a flame icon beside it, the other gas cloud icon with a crossed-out flame. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳能燃烧，二氧化碳不能。

shots.scene: 两个气体云图标下方都有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cloud icons each with a yellow warning triangle beneath them. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度高了，两种都会伤人。

shots.scene: 一张空白任务卡被剪成几段小卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank task card splits into four smaller blank cards arranged in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：什么是工作安全分析？

shots.scene: 每段小卡片旁出现危害三角和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Each small blank card gets a yellow warning triangle and a shield icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 把工作拆成步骤，逐步找危害。

shots.scene: 小研在白板上画四个方框，用箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws four boxes connected by arrows on a whiteboard, the boxes left blank.
shots.narration: 工作安全分析分四步。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白表格，对着实验步骤逐行填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank table line by line next to a lab bench, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 先选工作，再拆成步骤。

shots.scene: 阿杰在每一行旁画危害三角和打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank table where warning triangles and green check marks are added row by row. No people.
shots.narration: 每步找危害，再定控制措施。

shots.scene: 三个氢原子结构图标，原子核里中子数不同
shots.prompt_en: Three simple atom icons with one electron each, their nuclei holding zero, one and two extra neutral particles. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：什么是同位素？

shots.scene: 三个原子图标上方同一个数字符号高亮
shots.prompt_en: The three atom icons with matching highlighted proton dots and differently sized nuclei. No people.
shots.narration: 质子数相同，质量数不同。

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志图标和带锁的储存柜
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign next to a locked storage cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性同位素要按规定管理。

shots.scene: 钟表图标和一条平稳的浓度曲线
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a flat line chart with a dashed limit line above it. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么是时间加权平均浓度？

shots.scene: 一周日历，五天亮起，每天一个时钟
shots.prompt_en: A weekly calendar icon with five workdays highlighted, each with a small clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按每天、每周的工作时间平均。

shots.scene: 研究人员在通风良好的实验室里工作，表情轻松
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works calmly at a fume hood in a well-ventilated lab, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 长期接触也不该损害健康。

shots.scene: 空白标准文件图标，旁边三个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A blank standards booklet icon with three blank tabs on its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 国内看职业接触限值国家标准。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标和一段短促的浓度尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a line chart with one short spike under a dashed limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：什么是短时间接触浓度？

shots.scene: 尖峰旁的短时钟图标被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The short spike on the chart highlighted with a small clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间接触也有上限，不能超。

shots.scene: 骷髅图标、心跳线图标和红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A skull pictogram next to a heartbeat line icon inside a red warning frame. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么是立即威胁生命浓度？

shots.scene: 一个小人图标快速逃离气体云
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram running away from a dark gas cloud toward an exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 到这个浓度，马上危及生命健康。

shots.scene: 空白数字牌被打叉，旁边是撤离图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank number plate crossed out, next to an evacuation arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体数值不靠记，靠检测和撤离。

shots.scene: 一杯液体上方飘着蒸气，旁边温度计
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of liquid with vapor rising above it, next to a thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：什么是闪点？

shots.scene: 蒸气遇小火花一闪而灭
shots.prompt_en: The vapor above the beaker flashes briefly near a tiny spark and goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气遇火源能被点着的最低温度。

shots.scene: 实验柜里易燃液体瓶上贴火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A row of bottles in a flammable storage cabinet, each with a flame pictogram on a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点越低，越容易着火。

shots.scene: 蒸气点燃后火焰持续燃烧
shots.prompt_en: The vapor above the beaker ignites and keeps burning steadily, with a small timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：什么是燃点？

shots.scene: 温度计上两条刻线：低的闪点，高的燃点
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with two marks, a lower one and a higher one. No people.
shots.narration: 点着后能持续烧，燃点比闪点高。

shots.scene: 一条浓度条，两端暗、中间红色
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal concentration bar, dark at both ends with a red flame zone in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：爆炸下限和上限。

shots.scene: 浓度条左端标记点亮
shots.prompt_en: The left boundary of the red zone on the bar lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 能燃烧的最低浓度，叫下限。

shots.scene: 浓度条右端标记点亮
shots.prompt_en: The right boundary of the red zone on the bar lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 能燃烧的最高浓度，叫上限。

shots.scene: 通风柜排风箭头，把浓度推离红区
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with exhaust arrows, and the concentration marker sliding away from the red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 通风、密闭，别让蒸气进这个区间。

shots.scene: 四色菱形图标：红蓝黄白
shots.prompt_en: A diamond-shaped hazard icon divided into red, blue, yellow and white sections, all blank. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：四色危险菱形。

shots.scene: 菱形四块依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The four colored sections of the diamond light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 红易燃，蓝健康，黄反应，白特殊。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着菱形，摇摇头再指向另一边的象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the diamond icon, then turns and points at a set of red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms.
shots.narration: 这是国外标识，国内看象形图。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白许可单上签字，递给老李
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank permit form and hands it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 第十三题：什么是作业许可？

shots.scene: 许可单旁出现地点、时钟和盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with three icons beside it: a map pin, a clock, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 授权人签发，限定地点和时间。

shots.scene: 老李在作业点挂好许可单，检查措施
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs the blank permit at a work spot and checks a barrier and an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 措施落实了，才能开工。

shots.scene: 八个作业图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Eight icons in two rows: a toolbox, a flame, a lightning bolt, a manhole, a shovel, a radiation trefoil, a crane hook, and a water jet nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：作业许可有哪些？

shots.scene: 前四个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The toolbox, flame, lightning bolt and manhole icons highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 一般、动火、电气、受限空间。

shots.scene: 后四个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The shovel, radiation trefoil, crane hook and water jet icons highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖、辐射、吊装、高压水射流。

shots.scene: 欣欣耸耸肩，身后几本不同颜色的空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shrugs in front of several blank manuals of different colors.
shots.narration: 各单位分类不同，按本单位规定。

shots.scene: 配电箱开关上挂着红色挂锁和空白挂牌
shots.prompt_en: A red padlock and a blank tag hanging on an electrical switch box. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：什么是上锁挂牌？

shots.scene: 老李给仪器断电，挂上锁和牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a lab instrument's power isolator and attaches a padlock and a blank tag.
shots.narration: 检修时隔离能量，防止被误开。

shots.scene: 有人伸手去开带锁开关，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for a locked switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 牌子挂着，谁也不能合闸。

shots.scene: 五个步骤图标用箭头连成一条
shots.prompt_en: Five icons connected by arrows: a clipboard, a switch turned off, a padlock, a start button with a question mark, and an unlocked padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌分五步。

shots.scene: 老李按下启动按钮，仪器毫无反应，他点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the start button of the locked-out instrument; nothing happens and he nods.
shots.narration: 上锁后试启动，确认真断了。

shots.scene: 老李完工后清点工具，取下锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer counts his tools on a tray, then removes his padlock from the switch.
shots.narration: 完工清点，本人取锁恢复。

shots.scene: 地下水池的检修口，只有一个窄窄的入口
shots.prompt_en: A narrow manhole opening leading down into a dark underground water tank. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：什么是受限空间？

shots.scene: 老李指着校园里的污水井、地下水箱图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at icons of a sewer manhole, an underground tank, and a large sealed vessel.
shots.narration: 进出受限，通风不良的空间。

shots.scene: 受限空间剖面图，五个危害图标浮在里面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of an enclosed tank with five hazard icons floating inside. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 一个小人图标在罐内倒下
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram collapsing inside the tank icon, with a warning triangle above. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧和毒气，几口就能放倒人。

shots.scene: 空白许可单和挂锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form and a padlock icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 进入前，先办许可、先隔离。

shots.scene: 风机向井口送风，气体检测仪图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ventilation fan blowing air into a manhole, with a gas detector icon showing a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 吹扫通风，检测合格再进入。

shots.scene: 老李在井口外监护，手拿空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands guard at a manhole opening holding a blank log sheet, a tripod rescue frame beside him.
shots.narration: 井口有人监护，备好救援。

shots.scene: 培训证书、照明灯、救援计划三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank training certificate, a safety lamp, and a blank rescue plan. No people.
shots.narration: 人员培训、照明、救援计划都要有。

shots.scene: 工地起重机吊着重物的简笔图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a crane lifting a heavy steel beam on a construction site. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：什么是关键吊装？了解即可。

shots.scene: 三个图标：吊物下方有电线、仪表接近满格、两台起重机
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a load lifted over power lines, a gauge needle near its maximum, and two cranes lifting one load. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备上方、接近满载、多机抬吊。

shots.scene: 持证操作的起重机司机图标
shots.prompt_en: A crane operator pictogram holding a blank certificate card. No people.
shots.narration: 起重作业须持证，按方案审批。

shots.scene: 小研从文件架取出一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a blank data sheet from a document rack next to a chemical cabinet.
shots.narration: 第十八题：什么是安全技术说明书？

shots.scene: 空白说明书展开成十六格
shots.prompt_en: A blank document unfolds into a grid of sixteen blank sections. No people.
shots.narration: 它分十六部分，讲清化学品的一切。

shots.scene: 理化性质、健康、安全、环境四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a flask, a heart, a shield, and a leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 性质、危害、防护、应急都在里面。

shots.scene: 阿杰实验前认真阅读说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank data sheet carefully at his bench before starting work, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 用新试剂前，先读说明书。

shots.scene: 工人在地面挖深沟的简笔图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a deep trench dug in the ground with a shovel beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一题：深挖沟，要什么许可？

shots.scene: 深沟图标旁出现受限空间许可图标
shots.prompt_en: The trench icon with a blank permit form and a manhole icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片企业按受限空间许可管理。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着国内规范的空白文件
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank standards booklet.
shots.narration: 国内动土作业按规范审批。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
shots.scene: 墙上的气体报警器闪红灯、鸣响
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas detector flashes red with sound waves around it. No people.
shots.narration: 回到阿杰：报警器响了怎么办？
overlay: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急

shots.section_title: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰捂住口鼻，沿疏散箭头往外走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student cover their noses and walk out along an evacuation arrow.
shots.narration: 不闻、不找，立刻撤离。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
shots.scene: 气体钢瓶阀门图标，旁边打叉的小人在屋里
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder valve icon and a person pictogram inside a room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要冒险返回关阀。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
shots.scene: 小研在门外打电话，老周赶来
shots.prompt_en: Outside the lab door, the female graduate student makes a phone call as the older man hurries over.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和保卫处，等专业处置。

shots.section_title: 有毒气体报警与泄漏应急
shots.scene: 电话图标，旁边119和120两个号码牌
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to two blank number plates. No people.
shots.narration: 有人中毒或着火，拨打120和119。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息
shots.scene: 液氮罐、干冰箱、气体钢瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a liquid nitrogen dewar, a dry ice box, and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳不可燃，却会让人窒息。
overlay: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息
shots.scene: 小房间剖面，冷气在地面堆积
shots.prompt_en: A small room cross-section icon with cold gas spreading across the floor and an oxygen icon fading. No people.
shots.narration: 在小房间里，它们会挤走氧气。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息
shots.scene: 冷库门口的氧含量报警器和通风扇
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level alarm and a ventilation fan beside a cold room door. No people.
shots.narration: 开门通风，看氧含量报警。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳和惰性气体会窒息
shots.scene: 密闭小屋里放干冰被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry ice box inside a closed small room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干冰、液氮别放在密闭小间。

shots.section_title: 国内化学品标签看象形图
shots.scene: 试剂瓶空白标签上印着红框菱形象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label printed with several red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 国内化学品标签，看象形图。
overlay: 国内化学品标签看象形图

shots.section_title: 国内化学品标签看象形图
shots.scene: 九个红框菱形象形图排成三行
shots.prompt_en: Nine red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms in three rows: flame, flame over circle, exploding bomb, gas cylinder, corrosion, skull and crossbones, exclamation mark, health hazard, environment. No people.
shots.narration: 九种象形图，各代表一类危险。

shots.section_title: 国内化学品标签看象形图
shots.scene: 标签上信号词位置高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank chemical label with the signal word area and the hazard statement area highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 再看信号词、危险说明和防范说明。

shots.section_title: 实验室危险作业要审批
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着焊枪图标想在实验室动手，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding torch in a lab room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里动火，不能说干就干。
overlay: 实验室危险作业要审批

shots.section_title: 实验室危险作业要审批
shots.scene: 老周和王老师在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator sign a blank approval form at a desk.
shots.narration: 动火、进井、登高，先报批。

shots.section_title: 实验室危险作业要审批
shots.scene: 老李清走易燃物，摆好灭火器，保卫处值班员在旁监护
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clears flammable bottles away, places a fire extinguisher, and then starts work while the security officer watches.
shots.narration: 清走易燃物，有人监护再作业。

shots.section_title: 受限空间：严禁盲目施救
shots.scene: 井口下有人倒下，旁人想直接跳下去，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one person collapsed at the bottom of a manhole and another person about to jump in, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人倒在井下，千万别直接下去。
overlay: 受限空间：严禁盲目施救

shots.section_title: 受限空间：严禁盲目施救
shots.scene: 多个倒下的小人图标叠在井下
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several person pictograms lying at the bottom of a manhole with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 盲目施救，往往一倒一串。

shots.section_title: 受限空间：严禁盲目施救
shots.scene: 老李在井口用三脚架绳索施救，戴呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing a breathing apparatus operates a tripod rescue winch at a manhole opening.
shots.narration: 在外呼救，由专业人员带装备救援。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现气体瓶和检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a gas cylinder and a gas detector.
shots.narration: 有毒气体不靠闻，靠检测。

shots.scene: 温度计和浓度条图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and a concentration bar with a red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点、燃点、爆炸极限要心中有数。

shots.scene: 象形图标签和说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent label with hazard pictograms next to a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂标签，先读说明书。

shots.scene: 许可单和挂锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form and a padlock with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 危险作业先审批，检修要上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 井口、风机、监护人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a manhole, a ventilation fan, and a guard pictogram with a rescue tripod. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间先通风检测，不盲目施救。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 答对了吗？下期再见！
